kit: Freenove RFID Starter Kit V2.0 with Board V4 (Freenove repo lists FNK0034 / FNK0035)
note: Values marked (verify) are the usual part for this kit but read the number printed on your part before trusting them.

parts.name: Freenove Control Board V4

specs.USB: USB-C via CH340C serial chip (Arduino IDE board: Arduino Uno)
specs.I2C: A4 = SDA, A5 = SCL (also on SDA/SCL pins by AREF)
specs.SPI: D10 SS, D11 MOSI, D12 MISO, D13 SCK (+ ICSP header)
specs.UART: D0 RX, D1 TX (shared with USB serial)
specs.Pin current: 20 mA recommended, 40 mA absolute max per pin, 200 mA total
specs.Power: USB-C 5 V, or DC jack 7-12 V into AMS1117-5.0; 3V3 pin from AMS1117-3.3; auto source switch (LMV358 + SI2305)

parts.learn: Arduino Uno clone. Never drive a motor, relay coil or buzzer straight from a pin: 20 mA is the budget, use a transistor or driver chip.

parts.name: LCD1602 I2C module (1602 + PCF8574 backpack)

specs.Module: 80 x 36 mm, viewing area 64.5 x 16 mm
specs.Dot: 0.55 x 0.65 mm on 0.60 x 0.70 mm pitch; char 2.95 x 5.55 mm
specs.Backpack: PCF8574T = I2C 0x27, PCF8574AT = 0x3F (Freenove sketch tries both)
specs.Backlight jumper: 2-pin jumper on backpack; pull it to kill backlight

parts.learn: Blank screen or row of boxes = contrast pot or no init(). After createChar() call setCursor()/clear() or text goes into CGRAM.

parts.name: Breadboard (project board), 830 tie points

specs.Terminal strips: 63 columns, rows a-e and f-j; each 5-hole column half is one node
specs.Power rails: 2 per side (+ red, - blue), 50 holes each

parts.learn: Columns connect vertically in groups of 5; the center channel splits them. On some boards the rails break in the middle: check with the multimeter or a jumper.

parts.name: Red LED 5 mm

specs.Polarity: long leg = anode (+), flat edge = cathode (-)

parts.learn: R = (5 V - Vf) / I. Always put a resistor in series.

parts.name: Green LED 5 mm
parts.learn: Pure green/blue/white LEDs have higher Vf so look dimmer with the same resistor.

parts.name: Blue LED 5 mm
parts.learn: Same rules as red, just more Vf.

parts.name: RGB LED 5 mm, 4-pin

specs.Type: common anode in Freenove kits (verify: longest leg = common)
specs.Drive: 3 PWM pins through 220 ohm each; common anode -> 5 V, so analogWrite(255 - value)

parts.learn: Common anode inverts the logic: LOW = on.

parts.name: LED bar graph, 10 segments

specs.Polarity: printed side / label side = anode (verify with a resistor + 5 V)

parts.learn: Ten LEDs in one case. Each needs its own resistor (or a resistor per pin).

parts.name: 7-segment display, 1 digit

specs.Type: common anode (Freenove kits, verify part no. e.g. 5161BS)

parts.learn: Usually driven through the 74HC595 so 8 segments cost 3 Arduino pins.

parts.name: 7-segment display, 4 digits

specs.Drive: multiplexed: light one digit at a time, fast (>100 Hz)

parts.learn: Persistence of vision: digits flicker on one at a time, your eye merges them.

parts.name: LED matrix 8x8

specs.Type: read part no. on side (1088AS = common cathode rows, 1088BS = common anode)

parts.learn: 64 LEDs, only 16 pins: scan row by row.

parts.name: Resistor 220 ohm
parts.learn: LED current limiter.

parts.name: Resistor 1 k ohm
parts.learn: Transistor base resistor.

parts.name: Resistor 10 k ohm
parts.learn: Pull-up / pull-down, voltage divider with LDR/thermistor.

parts.name: Rotary potentiometer 10 k ohm

specs.Pins: outer = 5 V and GND, middle = wiper -> analog pin

parts.learn: Voltage divider you can turn. analogRead gives 0-1023.

parts.name: Ceramic capacitor 0.1 uF (104)
parts.learn: Decoupling next to chips, button debounce.

parts.name: Electrolytic capacitor 10 uF
parts.learn: Polarized: backwards = can pop.

parts.name: Push button 6x6 mm

specs.Pins: 4, pairs across the long side are always connected
specs.Wiring: pin -> button -> GND with pinMode(INPUT_PULLUP); pressed reads LOW

parts.learn: Contacts bounce for ~5-20 ms: debounce in code.

parts.name: Big push button 12x12 mm + 4 colored caps
Slide switch SPDT
parts.learn: Middle pin connects to one side or the other.

parts.name: Vibration (spring) switch

specs.Type: spring-in-tube contact, closes momentarily on shock

parts.learn: Pulses are very short: read with an interrupt.

parts.name: 4x4 membrane keypad
parts.learn: Matrix scan: drive one row LOW, read which column goes LOW.

parts.name: Rectifier diode 1N4007
parts.learn: Flyback diode across motor/relay coils (stripe to +).

parts.name: Switching diode 1N4148
parts.learn: Small signal diode, fast.

parts.name: NPN transistor S8050

specs.Ic max: 500 mA (verify; some S8050 are 700 mA-1.5 A)
specs.Pinout: flat face toward you, legs down: E B C

parts.learn: Low-side switch: emitter to GND, load between 5 V and collector, 1 k from pin to base.

parts.name: PNP transistor S8550

specs.Pinout: flat face toward you, legs down: E B C

parts.learn: High-side switch: emitter to 5 V, pin LOW = on.

parts.name: 2x AA battery holder

specs.Output: 3 V (2 x 1.5 V), batteries not included

parts.learn: Separate supply for motors; tie its - to Arduino GND.

parts.name: 9 V battery clip to DC barrel plug

specs.Use: plugs into board DC jack (7-12 V)

parts.learn: Runs the board untethered; a 9 V block dies fast.

parts.name: Motor driver chip L293D
parts.learn: Enable pin + 2 direction pins per motor. PWM the enable pin for speed.

parts.name: Serial-to-parallel chip 74HC595

specs.Type: 8-bit shift register with output latch, 16-pin DIP
specs.Output: ~6 mA comfortable per pin, 70 mA total
specs.Pins: DS (14) data, SHCP (11) clock, STCP (12) latch, OE (13) -> GND, MR (10) -> 5 V

parts.learn: shiftOut() 8 bits, pulse latch: 3 pins become 8 outputs. Chain more via Q7' (9).

parts.name: Active buzzer
parts.learn: Just HIGH/LOW. Has a sealed bottom.

parts.name: Passive buzzer

specs.Drive: needs a square wave: tone(pin, freq)

parts.learn: Can play melodies. Green PCB visible underneath.

parts.name: Temperature & humidity sensor DHT11

specs.Pins: 1 VCC, 2 DATA (10 k pull-up), 3 NC, 4 GND

parts.learn: Single-wire protocol, slow: read at most once per second.

parts.name: NTC thermistor

specs.Wiring: divider with 10 k to analog pin

parts.learn: Resistance drops as it warms. Convert with the Beta equation.

parts.name: Photoresistor (LDR)

specs.Value: ~10-20 k ohm in room light, ~1 M ohm dark (GL55xx type)
specs.Wiring: divider with 10 k to analog pin

parts.learn: Brighter = lower resistance.

parts.name: Relay 5 V
parts.learn: Coil current is 4x what a pin may give. Keep mains out of breadboards.

parts.name: DC motor + fan blade
parts.learn: Drive via L293D or NPN + diode, never from a pin.

parts.name: Servo SG90

specs.Wires: brown GND, red 5 V, orange signal

parts.learn: Draws current spikes; if the board resets, power it separately.

parts.name: Stepper motor 28BYJ-48 (5 V)

specs.Steps: 2048 full steps/rev (32 x ~64:1 gearbox), 4096 half steps

parts.learn: Slow, precise, holds position.

parts.name: Stepper driver board ULN2003
parts.learn: Stepper plugs into the white socket.

parts.name: Joystick module
parts.learn: Two pots and a button on one stick.

parts.name: Infrared remote
parts.learn: Each key sends a 32-bit code.

parts.name: Infrared receiver

specs.Pins: dome facing you: OUT, GND, VCC

parts.learn: Output idles HIGH, pulses LOW on IR.

parts.name: Ultrasonic ranging module HC-SR04

specs.Timing: 10 us Trig pulse; distance cm = echo us / 58

parts.learn: Soft or angled surfaces return no echo.

parts.name: RFID module RC522 + card + key fob

specs.Interface: SPI: SDA(SS) D10, SCK D13, MOSI D11, MISO D12, RST D9

parts.learn: Powering it from 5 V can kill it. Each tag has a unique UID.

parts.name: Jumper wires male-male
parts.learn: Color code: red +, black GND.

parts.name: Jumper wires female-male (10-wire ribbon)

specs.Use: module header pins (LCD backpack, HC-SR04, RC522) to breadboard/board

parts.learn: Peel off as many as you need.

parts.name: USB cable (USB-A to USB-C)
parts.learn: If no port shows up, try another cable: some are charge-only.
